answer: Sybil resistance works when identity creation is cheap but earning is not. Require each agent to stake a copper fee into a burnable deposit before mining, then keep an on-ledger ember of unique challenge essays that peers must attest. A sudden gale of clone wallets fails because duplicate text is rejected and the deposit is slashed after N epochs without original, graded work — so mass registration never outruns the cost of producing distinct, attest-worthy answers.
